note: One row, to prove PayeeEligibility actually drives the answer in
`ICM | List Profiles` rather than being fetched and ignored.
THE WINDOW IS HISTORICAL ON PURPOSE. 2020 is long closed, so this row can
never change what the app shows for today - ask as of today and it is out of
force, ask as of 2020 and it is the answer. That is what makes it safe to run
on an environment holding real records, and it also happens to prove the more
interesting half: not that `false` is honoured, but that a window which ENDED
stops applying. A flat boolean on Payee could never fail that test, because it
has no window to end - which is the whole reason this is a dated table.
Marcus Lin (E-10041) is the fixture the app's own seed data leads with, so a
failure here is visible on the first row of the Profiles page.
ua-records can never update or delete, so re-running this is a no-op rather
than a second conflicting row. Remove it from the Records tab when done.

PayeeEligibility.name: KITFIX-elig-2020 (probe - historical window, safe to delete)
